name: Live notes
notes: Live notes during and after a call

features.feature: During a call with live notes on, the Transcript tab shows the live transcript with Now, Decisions, Action items and Open questions beside it, each with a time jump; the first after about 90 s

The live header shows the call's model, the state (waiting, updating, updated N ago, failed, busy, signing in, paused, ended), Pause / Resume, usage, and what to do about a sign-in or settings problem
After the call the live notes stay beside the final transcript (searchable) and go into `transcript.md` as a "Live notes" draft
With live notes off a recording call says how to turn them on, and nothing is sent to a model
"Last time" (still to do, highlights) shows during a recurring call; Ask Claude about this call opens the Claude panel
